Attention GymRats!

The individual Classification Phase officially closes tonight at 23:59!

Here's FAQ for everybody:

.

Q: What happens after midnight? What do I do now?
A: Just keep playing the game!  Nothing changes on your end. We're locking the data window at 23:59 tonight purely to run the numbers for team building. Keep logging your workouts for your own totals, but just know that the fair team distribution will be calculated using your stats up until midnight tonight. 

.

Q: When will I find out what team I’m on?
A: We’re aiming to announce the official teams next week, likely by May 28th. 

.

Q: How are you sorting us into teams?
A: We want a level playing field, so we’re splitting everyone up based on your performance over the last 2 weeks. We aren't just looking at total points—we're factoring in your workout frequency and the types of activities you do. We want a fun mix, so don't worry, no single team is going to be accidentally stacked with just hardcore runners! 

.

Q: What if I didn't hit the 40-point mark?
A: All players who finished under 40 points will be grouped together into a "Reserve Bench" team. While you won't jump straight into the main Battle Royale rotation next week, definitely keep tracking your fitness habits! If you stay active, you can join the Battle Royale later as a mid-season reinforcement to take the spot of players who drop out.

Attention @all

Tomorrow, while you are enjoying the Summer Party, we have a super simple challenge for you and your team: The Summer Party Team Photo Challenge!

All you have to do is gather your teammates at the party tomorrow, take a group photo, and log it in the app under the specific activity: "Team photo challenge!"

The Reward 🎁

+1 Point for every individual player who uploads the team photo.
Up to +12 Extra Points for your team total if you manage to gather all 12 members of your team!


This is the perfect excuse to finally meet your teammates in person, socialize, and secure some easy extra points for your team leaderboard.
As we approach the final stretch of the challenge, we know that every single point matters! 

Have a great time tomorrow! ☀️🥤⛱️

The reopening was meant to allow users to add proof to their existing check-ins and ensure they were valid, not to add new check-ins for dates that were already past. That's why those check-ins were removed.

Exactly. I added checkin against the ones that I removed. Earlier they were marked as hiking, and I had to delete them and add them again as walking. Because I could not find a way to edit them directly as walking.
@Zouhair Guijjane have you added back my check-ins?

I understand why you did that. However, according to the rules, the reopened period was only to edit or update existing check-ins by adding proof, not to delete them and create new ones. If the category couldn't be changed, the correct approach would have been to contact the admins rather than creating new ones for past dates. That's why the newly created check-ins couldn't be accepted as they do not follow the rules.
https://cdn.gymrats.app/660fd702-e77e-4dd8-90d5-5d8f53b9aa61.jpg

As shown in the screenshot, the restriction was lifted so participants could fix their past check-ins, not recreate them. Irina was able to adjust her previous check-ins once the time restriction was removed, which shows that the intention was to edit existing entries rather than delete them and submit new ones.
